name: Cacophonic Shield

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: A 10-foot Emanation deals 3d6 Thunder on a failed Constitution save, half on success. Failure also Deafens until your next turn starts. Trigger on entry, movement into a creature, or end of turn, at most once per turn; designate exempt creatures when casting. You resist Thunder and incoming ranged attacks have Disadvantage. Add 1d6 damage per slot above 3.
